# AI Inference Pricing

`ai-inference-pricing` · v1.0.0 · Design · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/ai-inference-pricing/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Does our AI plan's price cover inference at normal and spike usage, and what included usage and overage keep us at our target margin?

**Inputs:** Plan price and basis, task types with usage and tokens, the model prices the founder checked (with dates), routing, included usage and overage, free tier, other variable costs, and the founder's target margin.

**Output:** Inference cost per task and per active user, all-in margin per paid account at normal and spike usage, break-even price and usage, free-tier cost per paid account, a healthy/thin/underwater verdict, and the top three margin levers.

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill ai-inference-pricing`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/ai-inference-pricing/resources/inference-pricing.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/ai-inference-pricing/resources/inference-pricing.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It holds no model prices. Every result rests on the prices you enter and their dates; a price checked more than 90 days ago, or undated, is flagged but still used.
- It models one typical paid account from averages (users, active share, tasks per user). Spread between accounts shows up only through the single spike multiplier, so also run your heaviest account's real usage.
- The spike and the usage break-even scale paid usage only; the free tier stays at its normal level. Model a free-tier surge by raising its inputs.
- Levers are fixed what-if moves (price, routing, tokens, included tasks, free usage), not an optimisation. The routing lever assumes the cheaper model does the task as well, which has to be tested first.

**Review before acting:** The founder or finance lead re-checks every model price on the provider's own page, records the date, and confirms tokens per task come from product logs before the price or usage limits go on the pricing page. The target margin is theirs, not a benchmark.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-inference-pricing](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/ai-inference-pricing)
